evidence: 1274 origins collapse to 98 point trajectories and 14 profiles.
impact: Row-wise uncertainty estimates would be overconfident and random splits would leak trajectory identity.
remediation: Use temporal manifests, rolling origin, leave-profile-out, and leave-zone-out only.

evidence: 18 inconsistent membership rows map to 6 unlabeled origins; 4 are REF and 8 WORK rows have no eligible prior origin.
impact: The previously disconnected counts 18 and 6 can now be audited row by row.
remediation: Keep the 6 origins out of loss; patch membership status in the next source-data revision.

evidence: 58 sample_id values encode a historical target token different from canonical target_campaign_id.
impact: Humans or code that parses sample_id may silently recover the wrong target semantics.
remediation: Treat sample_id as an opaque join key in v1; regenerate IDs and version all manifests in a future data revision.

impact: Imputation and missingness indicators will materially affect several feature families.
remediation: Fit imputation on train only, retain missing indicators, and report ablations for sparse terrain/uncertainty fields.

evidence: T5 has 17 complete positive labels in total and only 1 in test_complete.
impact: Headline classification metrics will have very high variance and threshold tuning is fragile.
remediation: Use average precision, fixed-FPR recall, confidence intervals, and treat T5 conclusions as exploratory.

evidence: Largest T1 train-to-test numeric drift is n_history with |SMD|=2.320.
impact: Temporal generalization is harder than within-period validation and must drive model selection.
remediation: Report drift-aware temporal results and avoid random resampling.

evidence: No authoritative zone_id exists; spatial_quadrants_v1 freezes coordinate-median quadrants for split-only use.
impact: The proxy supports reproducible spatial OOD checks but is not an engineering zoning claim.
remediation: Replace with a domain-governed zone map in a new split version when available.

evidence: The model-facing loader seals test until a matching frozen-candidate record is present; raw source CSVs remain audit-readable.
impact: Accidental model/test coupling is blocked in project APIs, but deliberate direct file access is not cryptographically prevented.
remediation: Run models through skru1.splits.load_split_dataset and retain source-code scanning in CI.
